{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.head())
print(df.info())
print(f"\nUnique patient_id count: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}\nTotal rows: {len(df)}\nDuplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"\nDuplicate patient_id rows: {df[df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False)].shape[0]} rows")

# Check assay_batch distribution
print(f"\nAssay batch distribution: {df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"\nMax sample_seq per patient (first 5): {sample_seq_max.head().to_dict()}")"}
